scope: Embedded capture-time screenshots of the two pinned GSDumps; raw *-GS.bin savestate memory images carry no screenshot and are excluded.
claim_limits: The frames are the screenshots PCSX2 embedded at dump-save time (capture-time GS output), not frames from a fresh headless replay of the dumps.

Replaying a dump into a PNG is environment-bound on the pinned builds: PINE refuses savestates during replay, the screenshot hotkey needs a GUI session, and pcsx2-gsrunner is not shipped in the pinned macOS bundle or the pinned Linux image. The replay cross-check of these frames is open.
One dump is a race chase frame, the other a menu frame; the receipt labels content only through the dump names and does not claim both show car renders.
PNG encoding uses the stdlib zlib at its default level; determinism across zlib versions is assumed, not proven. screenshot_sha256 pins the source bytes.
